name: Welcome Flow (7 Emails + 2 SMS)
purpose: Engage new subscribers, educate them on the brand, position it as the leader in its space, get past trust doubts, get the first purchase, and keep reminding them of the welcome offer. 7 emails = Email #1's three versions + #2–#5; each subscriber receives 5.

source.note: Fluid flow system v2, distilled from 31 client strategies (fluid-flow-strategist skill)

profileFilter.description: Placed Order zero times since starting this flow

actions.job: Welcome + deliver the offer to subscribers who answered Option #1
subject: Welcome to {{brand.name}}! Here's your {{offers.welcome}}, or a topic built on their answer ("Something to reach for at 3pm that isn't coffee")
actions.name: Email #1: Welcome Offer (Option #1)
actions.topic: Welcome to {{brand.name}}! Here's your {{offers.welcome}}, or a topic built on their answer ("Something to reach for at 3pm that isn't coffee")
actions.offer: W (welcome offer) with Code and Value

all: Welcome to the brand
Give them their offer: Code {{offers.welcome_code}}, Value {{offers.welcome}}
Go over the brand mission (BRAND)
Highlight the benefit / category they chose ("{{popup.option_1}}"), in their words, and how the brand delivers it
Highlight 3 best-selling products for this option (DATA: top first-order products in option 1), one line each
Same messaging and offer in all three versions; only the products and the benefit/category paragraph change
replenishable: Optional: trust signals (testing, certifications, review count), subscription or bundle options, a secondary CTA
one_off: Add any ongoing offer and the "codes can't be combined" line (e.g. Buy Any 2, Get the 3rd Free)
Trust basics for the category: fit and sizing (apparel), materials/warranty/care (jewelry), dimensions/delivery (home), compatibility/expert help (gear)
Optional: the AOV angle (build a rotation, layer pieces, complete the set); expert-help CTA for high-ticket

actions.job: Welcome + the code (Klaviyo skips profiles without SMS consent)
actions.body: Welcome to {{brand.name}}! Here's {{offers.welcome}} off your first order: {{offers.welcome_code}}. {{links.shop}}

actions.job: Highest-trust email in the flow: the founder in their own words
subject: A note from {{brand.founder_first_name}}
actions.name: Email #2: Personal Note from the Founder

all: Plain text. Never designed: it reads as personal
The founder's story by name (BRAND)
Why the brand exists
Invite a reply
Soft reminder of the code
replenishable: The decision it made on purpose (quality over margin, taking ingredients out)
one_off: Why they do things differently; what they won't compromise on (quality, honest advice, never a sale ahead of the right fit)

actions.job: Social proof that answers the category's main objection
subject: Here's what people are saying about {{brand.name}}
actions.name: Email #3: Customer Reviews
actions.topic: Here's what people are saying about {{brand.name}}

all: Authentic reviews in the preferred structure: situation → problem → experience → outcome they reported (never fabricated)
Review count and where it lives (BRAND)
Remind them of the code without making it the reason to buy
replenishable: Before/after stories, customer photos
Reassure the category's main objection (taste, does it work, will it match my skin)
one_off: Reviews and customer photos that answer this category's trust doubts ("looks better than the photos", "fit true to size", "they helped me pick the right board")

actions.job: Show the easiest place to start
subject: Our best sellers
actions.name: Email #4: Best Seller Showcase

all: The core products / best sellers (DATA: what NEW customers buy first, ties broken by repeat rate)
replenishable: How each one fits a need
The easiest place to start
one_off: A guided tour of the shop, not a product dump; each with who it's for
High-ticket catalogs: include an entry-price product

actions.job: First direct ask: the upgraded offer, 24 hours only
subject: Your offer just went up, for 24 hours
actions.name: Email #5: Upgrade offer for only 24 hours
actions.topic: Your offer just went up, for 24 hours
actions.sendingTo: New subscribers who have not purchased
actions.offer: W + 5 points for 24 hours (dollar offers double); new code {{offers.welcome_upgrade_code}}

all: Upgrade the offer for 24 hours (offer ladder)
The first direct ask to shop
replenishable: Subscription or rewards if the client has them
one_off: State exclusions (high-ticket, MAP-restricted, custom quotes) where they apply
Expert help before ordering for considered purchases

actions.job: The upgraded code and the 24-hour deadline
actions.body: 24 hours only: your {{brand.name}} offer is now {{offers.welcome_upgrade}} off with {{offers.welcome_upgrade_code}}. {{links.shop}}

notes: Klaviyo branches can't merge, so Emails #2–#5 and both SMS repeat on each of the three tracks (sameAs points to track A): write them once. SMS steps are skipped by Klaviyo for profiles without SMS consent, which replaces the docs' 'if subscribed to SMS' split.
